final: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, average_ratio, ABS(average_ratio - (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM type_averages)) AS distance_from_mean FROM type_averages ORDER BY type
